description: The collaborating transport researchers publish a dataset for reproducing a dynamic multimodal transportation-network model of Melbourne, Australia. Network and associated model inputs are expressed in General Modeling Network Specification tables, a software-independent format for routable transport networks. The Zenodo deposit provides twenty CSV files under CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse and inspection with ordinary tabular tools. Modellers can adapt the network to static or dynamic traffic simulations, compare assignment methods and test multimodal planning scenarios. This city-scale research representation is limited to the documented Melbourne network and is not a live traffic feed, and conversion into a particular simulator may require additional assumptions. Numerical consistency and calibration were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: An Open GMNS Dataset of a Dynamic Multi-modal Transportation Network Model of Melbourne, Australia
notes: G4-0439; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
provider: K. N. Toosi University of Technology, UNSW and CSIRO Data61
